seo_text.heading: About these Christmas gifts
seo_text.intro: Every gift in this guide is built around the same idea: cafe-quality coffee without the cafe, the machine, or the queue. Here is who each one suits.

parts.heading: The best gifts for someone who loves coffee
parts.body: If they already take coffee seriously, the Coffee Starter Pack is the safest gift on this page. It pairs a bottle of espresso concentrate with the Measuring Jigger, so they can pour an accurate shot into milk or water and have a flat white in about thirty seconds. For someone who orders a latte every time, the Latte Kit with Coffee goes further, and comes in Original, Decaf, Vanilla and Caramel, so you can match what they actually drink rather than guessing. If they already buy from us, skip the kits entirely and give them a refill of the Coffee Concentrate, which is the thing they will run out of first.

parts.heading: Coffee gifts under $20
parts.body: Secret Santa, teacher gifts and Kris Kringle all come with a budget and a deadline, which makes them the easiest gifts on this list to get right. The Measuring Jigger at $14.95 measures a single or double shot without any guesswork, and it is useful to anyone who makes coffee at home regardless of the brand they buy. The Hand Held Frother, also $14.95, whips cold milk into cafe-style foam in about ten seconds and turns an ordinary coffee into something that looks deliberate. Both are small enough to post cheaply and sturdy enough to survive a desk drawer until the party.

parts.heading: Left it too late?
parts.body: If posting is no longer fast enough, an Acme Coffee digital gift card is emailed immediately and can be bought at any hour, including on Christmas Eve. They run from $30 to $100, which covers everything from a stocking filler to a full coffee kit, and the recipient chooses the flavour themselves, which removes the one real risk of giving coffee as a gift.
